skill.summary: Manage elizaOS Cloud - deploy AI agents, chat completions, image/video generation, voice cloning, knowledge base, containers, and marketplace. Use when interacting with elizaOS Cloud, elizacloud.ai, deploying eliza agents, or managing cloud-hosted AI agents. Requires ELIZACLOUD_API_KEY environment variable.
